question: Why does secondary (settling) performance remain unmet in this execution even though terminal reach succeeded? Recorded summary: reach_passed = true with terminal_error_m = 0.0076 against reach_tolerance_m = 0.01, but sampled_settling_passed = false, with a late-window late_max_speed_m_s = 1.581 (vs speed_limit_m_s = 0.02) and late_max_error_m = 0.0581 (vs position_limit_m = 0.01) over a 0.05 s window, in a run where every update missed its deadline (deadline_misses = 35, stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop = 34, Solve_Succeeded = 1) and mean_update_s = 17.075 against control_period_s = 0.01, with horizon = 10, max_iterations = 120, max_cpu_s = 30.0, and a bundled_guess numerical_source. The question is open: which of the retained signals — per-update solve/status behaviour, plan/iteration selection, effective horizon, applied versus requested tension, projected-state evolution, sampled backend motion at matched endpoints — are consistent with a sustained late-window tip speed and position error after reach, and which remain indeterminate with available evidence? No root cause is presumed; a single bounded projected-model probe over a 10 ms horizon cannot by itself explain an entire settling failure and must not be presented as doing so.
scope: IN: retained-evidence reads of the common summary artifact (e87b0e85...) and the inventory manifest (f1a0ecce...), including summary_content.detail.summary and limitations.

IN: retained-evidence reads of the complete per-update inventories at their stated coverage - source.one_step_predictions, source.applied_tensions, source.saved_projected_states, source.plan_selection, source.solver_status, source.controller_horizon (each record_count 35, update_ids 0..34, time_coverage_s 0.0-0.34) and source.force_limits (/tendons, 6 channels) - via the raw_query pointers or the derived prediction/plans views, in batches of at most 8 update_ids per query.

IN: retained-evidence reads of source.backend_motion through its permitted derived views only (motion for the final settling window; prediction endpoint view for chosen controller updates, at most 8 per query), since its raw gzip bytes cannot be read as JSON via evidence.read. Signals of interest: deadline_missed, optimization_solve_s, optimization_status, optimization_selected_iteration, optimization_constraint_violation, plan_source, plan_accepted, unusable_updates, effective_horizon, failure_response_used, feasibility_recovery, requested_tension_n, actual_tension_n, predicted_tension_n, tension_tracking_error_n, force_limit_saturated, gvs_projection_residual_max_rad_m, tip_m, tension_n.

IN: at most one explicitly authorized saved-state numerical check under the host-supplied grant (model.gvs@1.0.0, horizon 0.01 s, implicit_euler, integration step 0.002 s, max_wall_s 300.0, max_checks 1, local_solves 6, prediction_evaluations 24), operating only at a saved projected state with a matching saved effective horizon; its outputs are treated as bounded local plan/endpoint differences, not as closed-loop settling evidence and not as causal attribution.

IN: reading order and coverage to be reported per entry as complete-retained, queried-with-stated-coverage, or not_read for an explicitly named unread subset; a sampled view or a failed raw gzip read is not evidence of absence.

OUT: production changes, configuration edits, backend execution/solves outside the host grant, and any use of the disabled local_comparison/prediction_braking operations beyond the single authorized check.

OUT: closed-loop counterfactual replay, full-trajectory reconstruction, continuous-time reconstruction, reconstruction of historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans, and any declaration of a dominant settling cause.

FRAMES: world frame for tip vectors; projected GVS coordinates for state; serial backend joint coordinates for backend motion; controller-update times are distinct from sampled post-step execution timestamps.
stopping_conditions: Stop and report when the retained evidence named in scope has been read at the stated coverage and the single authorized saved-state check has either produced a result or been explicitly denied/not-run, whichever occurs first.

Stop and mark indeterminate any sub-question that would require unretained data (source.historical_full_plans: control_snapshots.json not retained) or a capability listed as absent (closed-loop counterfactual replay, causal attribution, full backend replay).

Stop without asserting a dominant cause: the recorded limitations state that single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause, and a 10 ms projected-model probe cannot explain an entire settling failure.

Stop when the phase evidence-turn limit is reached and deliver the current phase using its remaining advertised handoff tool, reporting which inventory entries were read, which were queried with partial coverage, and which were not read in this context.
